entries.en: Collect a piece of poxyleaf waterweed.
Collect a piece of fancyleaf waterweed.
Collect a piece of gaudyleaf waterweed.
Return the waterweed samples to Tempatriq.
entries.fr: Donner les plantes aquatiques à Tempatriq

entries.en: Oh, what is Tempatriq to do? It is so near, and yet so far...
entries.fr: Bssshhhaaah<nbsp>! Tempatriq est très embêtée<nbsp>! Ce que lui demande la main-du-pot est impossible<nbsp>! La pauvre Mobeline peut pas plonger<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
困った　困った　どうしよう……
壺匠から　寄せられた　要求　難題　難しい！
さすがに　潜水　難しい～！

entries.en: Earlend Tempatriq, lowlander! She told potsworn friend about the beautiful waterweed of Marsh Ligaka, and potsworn friend says she wants to study it closeeyes.
entries.fr: La main-du-pot veut voir de près les plantes aquatiques qui poussent tout fond des marais de Ligaka<nbsp>! Mais qomment faire, bssshhhein<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
モブの担当　求めてる！
「リガカの潟」の水底に　生えてる　いろんな水草を
じっくり　ねっとり　見たいって！

entries.en: But waterweed grows at the bottom of the water, and Tempatriq can't fishwalk. Can't ask potsworn to collect it herself, either─it would go against the potpact. You wouldn't happen to be a talented fishwalker, would you?

entries.en: She is an expert at reproducing nature─not only in prettylooks, but in funnytraits, too. This waterweed has a very special funnytrait: it changes color depending on the warmth of the water in which it grows, its exposure to light, or even over the longyears.
entries.fr: Et elles ont aussi des vertus inqroyables<nbsp>! Oui, elles changent de qouleur en fonqtion de certaines qonditions comme la lumière du soleil ou la température de l'eau<nbsp>! Cette qaraqtéristique donnera forcément des idées à la main-du-pot<nbsp>! Bssshh...
entries.ja:
これらの水草　とっても不思議
日光　水温　いろんな条件　環境合わせて　色変わる！
観察すれば　色使い　感性　刺激　受けるはず！
